description: Export preferences, lessons, profile (and optionally raw interactions) to a JSON file under data/exports/. Only writes inside that directory. Returns the file path, size in bytes and a JSON preview.

filename.description: Output file name inside data/exports/ (only A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - allowed, must end with .json). Defaults to memory-export-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss.json

includeInteractions.description: Include raw interaction rows in the export (file gets bigger)

projectId.description: Scope export to this project's PROJECT-scoped memories

sessionId.description: Scope export to this session's SESSION-scoped memories

userId.description: Scope export to this user's USER-scoped memories (own only unless granted)

name: export_memory
title: Export memory to JSON
